# Research sites {#sec-research}

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
Today we'll be doing an overview and survey on Group Project topics. There will be in-class time to work on your project.
:::

## Group Project Topics

-Density/Population/Voting Rates or Turnout  
-Transportation Facilities  
-Geography/Topography  
-Wealth/Poverty/Education  
-Race/Ethnicity/Linguistic Isolation 

## Data Sources that might be useful

-`tidycensus` data for
 
  - [race and ethnicity](https://radicalresearch.llc/EA078_Fall2026/import3.html#example-2---los-angeles-county---racial-variables) 
  - [median household income](https://radicalresearch.llc/EA078_Fall2026/import3.html#example-1---los-angeles-census-tracts)
  - [poverty rates](https://walker-data.com/census-r/spatial-analysis-with-us-census-data.html?q=poverty#computing-demographic-estimates-for-zones-with-areal-interpolation) (B17010_001, B17010_002)

- `tigris` data for
  - `places()`
  - `roads()`
  - `rails()`

- CalEnviroScreen5.0 for
  - linguistic isolation
  - low educational attainment
  
- `sf` for
  - `st_centroid()` 
  - `st_distance()`
   

-Other  
  - population and density - provided or calculatable in class_GreenGrey.csv   
  - [CA voter registration rates and voting rates](https://statewidedatabase.org/d20/g24.html)
  - [Public airports](https://data.ca.gov/@caltrans/airport-boundaries)
  - [30x30 Terrestrial Conserved Areas](https://www.californianature.ca.gov)
